title: Model Exposure on One Device Endangers Others: Rethinking Edge Neural Network Security across Devices
abstract: arXiv:2610.27152v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural networks (NNs) are increasingly deployed on edge devices such as mobile and IoT platforms, offering low latency and improved privacy compared to cloud-based deployment. However, on-device models embedded in mobile applications can be unpacked and exposed to adversaries, enabling cross-node attacks in centrally distributed ecosystems, where adversarial examples crafted on one compromised device transfer effectively to other nodes sharing the same models. To address this threat, we propose VeilNN, a defense framework that reduces adversarial transferability across on-device models via model obfuscation. The core idea of VeilNN is to introduce controlled model diversity while preserving original task functionality. translated_title: 单台设备上的模型暴露危及他台设备：重新思考跨设备的边缘神经网络安全
translated_abstract: 神经网络越来越多地部署在移动和物联网平台等边缘设备上，与云端部署相比具有低延迟和更好隐私保护的优势。然而，嵌入在移动应用中的设备端模型可能被解包并暴露给攻击者，从而在集中分发的生态系统中引发跨节点攻击——在一台被攻陷设备上构造的对抗样本可以有效地迁移到共享相同模型的其他节点。为应对这一威胁，我们提出了VeilNN，一个通过模型混淆来降低设备端模型之间对抗样本可迁移性的防御框架。VeilNN的核心思想是在保持原始任务功能的同时引入受控的模型多样性。具体而言，VeilNN通过网络单元混淆和层组装，在架构和参数两个层面施加隐蔽且不可逆的混淆，并适用于多种神经网络架构……
tldr: 该论文提出VeilNN防御框架，通过对设备端神经网络在架构和参数层面施加隐蔽且不可逆的模型混淆，在保持任务功能的前提下引入受控模型多样性，从而有效降低对抗样本在共享相同模型的边缘设备之间的可迁移性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes VeilNN, a defense framework that reduces adversarial transferability across on-device models by applying stealthy and irreversible obfuscation at both the architectural and parameter levels, introducing controlled model diversity while preserving original task functionality.
